title: Reve de Mer 2 Lockoff Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Reve De Mer 2 Lockoff is a 2 BR / 2.5 BA / 5 Guest cottage in Seaside, FL. Enjoy sipping on drinks from the comfort of the home's large screened-in front porch as you reminisce about childhood days while swaying to and fro in the porch's swing or relaxing in the rocking chairs.
description_expanded: Description102 SAVANNAH STREET1 KING, 1 QUEEN, 1 TWINFully Renovated Seaside Cottage Near Beach & AmenitiesReve de Mer is a beautifully updated Seaside cottage offering the perfect blend of comfort, location, and coastal charm. A complete kitchen renovation and full renovation of all bathrooms were completed in April 2024, delivering refreshed interiors designed for effortless beach living. Ideally located near Seaside’s top amenities—including the fitness center, pool, scenic park, and private residential beach—this two-bedroom retreat places everything you love about Seaside just steps from your door.Inviting Outdoor Living & Classic Seaside CharmA spacious screened-in front porch welcomes guests with rocking chairs and a charming porch swing—an ideal setting for morning coffee, afternoon breezes, or unwinding after a day at the beach. Surrounded by Seaside’s lush landscaping, this porch invites you to slow down and settle into vacation mode the moment you arrive.Bright Living Spaces & Renovated KitchenStep inside through double glass doors to a warm and welcoming interior that truly feels like a home away from home. The newly refurnished living room offers comfortable seating, a flat-screen TV, and high-speed WiFi—perfect for movie nights, game nights, or quiet afternoons indoors. The fully renovated kitchen is thoughtfully equipped for both home-cooked meals and casual coastal dining, with easy access to the screened back porch for enjoying meals outdoors.Comfortable Bedrooms & Updated BathsThe first-floor primary bedroom serves as a peaceful retreat, featuring new furnishings, a flat-screen TV, a cozy window seat, and a fully renovated private bathroom. From the bath, step directly into your own private outdoor shower—perfect after a day in the sand and sun. Also on the first floor is a twin bedroom with access to a half bathroom and its own private outdoor shower area, offering flexibility and comfort for additional guests.Upstairs, a queen bedroom opens onto a private balcony—an inviting space for sunbathing, stargazing, or enjoying quiet moments surrounded by Seaside’s coastal atmosphere.A Relaxing Seaside Escape for Every StayWhether you’re grilling fresh local seafood, enjoying evenings on the porch, or making unforgettable beach memories with family and friends, Reve de Mer offers a thoughtfully renovated setting designed for relaxation and connection. With its prime location, updated interiors, and inviting outdoor spaces, this Seaside favorite provides everything you need for a memorable and carefree beach vacation.Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration. 3-night minimum Spring | 5-night minimum Summer | 3-night minimum Fall | 2-night minimum Winter. Not available during peak season.FEATURES Seaside Private Residential Beach at Savannah Pavilion2-minute walk (176 yards) to beach accessTwo enclosed outdoor showersLarge, gourmet-equipped kitchen with Calphalon and All-Clad cookwareWiFi throughout the homeTwo large LCD TVs with premium cable channelsCeiling fans in every roomPeacock Alley Linens – Fresh and luxurious Peacock Alley towels and sheets throughout the homeScreened outdoor dining patio off the kitchen with gas grillFull access to Seaside amenities, including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts & 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedTwo parking passes included for two-bedroom and larger homes. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited; special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permitNo petsSTR23-002374
